usage: policy for approved Docker Base Images
name: OpenSSL 3.0.0 to 3.0.6 should not be found in the Dockerfile configuration
description: Dockerfile configurations typically include the Operating System and other base images that are installed as part of the final docker image that will be deployed with your code. These base images may also utilize the OpenSSL vulnerable version and will need to be updated.
detailedDescription: Searching for direct and indirect dependencies in code is not enough to protect against OpenSSL 3.x vulnerability. Dependencies and base images that are also part of a docker creation need to be scanned as well. With this policy enabled vulnerable versions 3.0.0 to 3.0.6 of the OpenSSL library will be scanned in Docker files.
